page.title: 動詞が選ぶ to と-ing

analysis.summaryJa: to不定詞が「これから行う行為」を一つの名詞のかたまりとして扱い、文の主語・目的語・補語に入る仕組みを整理する。長い主語をItで後ろへ送る形や、what・when・howなどの疑問詞＋to不定詞も扱う。
grammarPoints: to＋動詞原形全体が主語・目的語・補語として働く
長いto不定詞主語は形式主語Itで後置できる
what・when・where・how＋to doが名詞句として働く
decide・hope・plan・aim・agreeなどの後ろでto不定詞が目的語になる
visualEvidence: TOの矢印で動詞が一まとまりの名詞箱へ入る図
主語・目的語・補語の三つの席にto不定詞が置かれる配置
重い主語をItが受け、to不定詞を後方へ送る矢印
疑問詞カードとTOカードが結合する図
commonTraps: toの直後を過去形や-ing形にする
形式主語Itとto不定詞の両方を主語の位置へ重ねる
to不定詞を取る動詞の後ろへ不自然な動名詞を置く

questions.prompt: ------- the inventory tonight will prevent delays.
questions.translationJa: 今夜在庫を数えることで遅延を防げます。
questions.explanationJa: 行為全体を主語にするためTo countを用います。

questions.prompt: The committee decided ------- the launch.
questions.translationJa: 委員会は発売を延期することを決めました。

questions.prompt: Our main goal is ------- response times.
questions.translationJa: 主な目標は応答時間を短縮することです。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞の後ろで目標の内容を説明する補語です。

questions.prompt: It is wise ------- copies off-site.
questions.translationJa: コピーを別の場所に保管するのは賢明です。

questions.prompt: The guide explains how ------- the scanner.
questions.translationJa: 案内書はスキャナーの操作方法を説明します。
questions.explanationJa: how＋to doで「方法」を表す名詞句です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ito hopes ------- the contract today.
questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは今日契約を確定したいと考えています。

questions.prompt: The issue is when ------- the maintenance.

questions.prompt: ------- every complaint promptly requires training.
questions.translationJa: すべての苦情へ迅速に答えるには訓練が必要です。

questions.prompt: The trainees learned ------- the device safely.
questions.translationJa: 研修生は装置を安全にリセットする方法を学びました。
questions.explanationJa: learn to doで技能の習得を表します。

questions.prompt: We have not chosen where ------- the kiosk.
questions.translationJa: 私たちは端末をどこに置くかまだ決めていません。
questions.explanationJa: where＋to doがchosenの目的語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a budget.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an objective.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using formal it.

choices.D: It is difficult predict to demand.

questions.explanationJa: Itを形式主語、to predict以下を真の主語にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about instructions.

choices.A: The manual shows us how replacing the filter.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a decision.

choices.A: The board agreed extending the trial.
choices.B: The board agreed to extend the trial.
choices.C: The board agree to extended the trial.
choices.D: The board agreed to extending the trial.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a meeting time.

choices.A: We must decide when to meet the supplier.
choices.B: We must decide when meeting the supplier.
choices.C: We must decide to when meet the supplier.
choices.D: We must decides when to met the supplier.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先といつ会うか決めなければなりません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about training.

choices.A: To trained all operators will take two days.
choices.B: Training to all operators will takes two days.
choices.C: To train all operators will take two days.
choices.D: To training all operators will take two days.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a target.

choices.A: The sales team aims reaching new customers.
choices.B: The sales team aims to reach new customers.
choices.C: The sales team aim to reaches new customers.
choices.D: The sales team aims to reached new customers.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a destination.

choices.A: The courier asked where leaving the parcel.
choices.B: The courier asked to where leave the parcel.
choices.C: The courier ask where to left the parcel.
choices.D: The courier asked where to leave the parcel.

questions.translationJa: 配達員は荷物をどこに置くか尋ねました。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "To verify every entry is essential."

choices.D: It is essential to verify every entry.

questions.translationJa: 各項目を確認することが不可欠です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "Our plan is to relocate in June."

questions.translationJa: 私たちは6月に移転する予定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The clerk knows how to issue a refund."

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "It is risky to share that password."
questions.translationJa: そのパスワードを共有するのは危険です。
questions.explanationJa: 形式主語構文を動名詞主語へ言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "We decided to replace the printer."

choices.B: We made a decision to replace the printer.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはプリンターを交換すると決めました。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The question is where to hold the workshop."

choices.D: We need to determine the workshop location.

questions.translationJa: 問題は研修会をどこで開くかです。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "To ignore the warning would be careless."

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The intern learned to use the database."

questions.translationJa: 研修生はデータベースの使い方を習得しました。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "We have yet to decide when to announce it."

questions.prompt: The shipment is delayed. We need to decide ------- the customer.

questions.prompt: The client requested revisions. Our goal is ------- them by noon.

questions.prompt: Several routes are blocked. The driver must choose which road ------- .
